title: Words of a card
description: A file in data/print/<lang>/card/entity/, such as data/print/ja/card/entity/sta/105.json. The words one print of a card shows in one language: the name, the type line, and the rules text. The file is keyed by the set and the collector number of the print that shows them. The type line keeps its supertypes, card types, and subtypes, and the rules text keeps one entry per ability. Flavor text is not here: each appearance shows its own, so it belongs to the print.

lang.description: The language of these words, such as ja.

set_code.description: The official code of the product whose print shows these words, such as STA.

number.description: The collector number of the print that shows these words, as printed; e.g. 170 or 170★.

name.description: The card name as printed in this language.

history.description: Records of official corrections to these values. Appended only; past records are never rewritten.

type_line.description: The supertypes, card types, and subtypes as this language prints them.

rules_text.description: The rules text as this language prints it, one entry per ability of the card.

ability_id.description: The ability_id of the ability this text belongs to in the card.

text.description: The rules text of that ability as printed in this language.
